description: The only places where a banned API (RS0030, architecture/BannedSymbols.*.txt) may be used, each through a [SuppressMessage("ApiDesign", "RS0030:Do not use banned APIs", Justification = "...")] at the narrowest scope. Architecture.Tests fails on any RS0030 suppression outside these paths, and its confined-API rules check in the compiled IL that each API is only called from the allowed namespace or type (blueprint §4.4, mechanism 3).

exceptions.justification: The single adapter behind IForegroundControl: every foreground change goes through ForegroundOrchestrator leases (ADR-0005).
The tray menu opens only inside the TrayMenu lease, with verified restoration afterwards.
LowLevelInjector is the product's only SendInput, behind IInputInjector and PressedInputRelease (ADR-0022).
ILauncher starts apps and web pages without a command interpreter, on the Shell thread (LOG-008, EJE-011).
ISystemCommandRunner runs system commands (brightness through WMI, shell verbs) on the Shell thread.
Relaunching elevated uses ShellExecuteEx("runas") after WinVerifyTrust and the pinned publisher check; the table of §4.4 omits it but §3.3 rule 2 requires it.
The implementation of IAtomicFileWriter: write, flush, ReplaceFileW and .prev (ADR-0007).
The rolling log file keeps a fixed name (clicalo.log, 5 x 1 MB) and cannot go through the atomic document writer.
IAppLifetime.ExitAsync releases every key before ending the process.
The last synchronous flush on process exit: WM_QUERYENDSESSION must be answered after it and cannot await. Bounded by Timings.App.ExitReleaseWait and ExitFlushTimeout; it never needs the UI thread.

PBT_APMSUSPEND: the machine may sleep as soon as WM_POWERBROADCAST is answered, so the SysEvents thread waits for the engine's release, bounded by Timings.KeySafety.SuspendReleaseWait (500 ms), then for the flush of the document, the usage and the queued copies, bounded by Timings.App.SuspendFlushTimeout. Bounded waits on SysEvents that §3.2 does not foresee: recorded in D-21 and D-22.
The second process of a session, before any window or engine exists: its STA Main cannot await and waits for one answer of the running instance, bounded by Timings.Ipc.IpcRequestTimeout, then ends.
The Control Center and the welcome are normal activatable windows; BannedSymbols.Surfaces.txt protects the panel surfaces, which never take the focus.
